visualBrief.sp-lisbon: Warm hilltop light, tiled streets, landmark riverfront and layered rooftops; easy-city arrival with unmistakable Lisbon character.
visualBrief.sp-sintra: Fairytale architecture and mossy garden mystery balanced by the dramatic Sintra coast.
visualBrief.sp-ponta: Golden limestone, turquoise water, arches and boats that communicate scale and the day’s coastal wow.
visualBrief.sp-lagos: A relaxed whitewashed town, broad beach, headland and sunset rhythm that sells an easy base.
visualBrief.sp-marinha: The Algarve’s clearest cliff-and-cove reveal, with arches, emerald water and nearby cave drama.
visualBrief.hero: Ten broad, crop-safe flagship frames spanning Lisbon light, Sintra fantasy and the Algarve’s turquoise limestone coast.
